closed_findings.executable_phases_1_to_4: A source-pinned coordinator validates one immutable contract, installs the exact policy, reserves the exact claim, publishes the exact asset, constructs and validates runtime artifacts, then invokes the existing held-first publisher.
closed_findings.lock_lifecycle: The coordinator releases the policy lock before the reservation helper reacquires it. The helper now runs an injected exact policy, ownership, capacity and unresolved-intent precondition inside its own lock before mutating the claim. Binding construction and publisher each reacquire and revalidate independently.
closed_findings.crash_recovery: The phase journal durably records pending before every mutation and completed only after its postcondition. Policy replacement has a pre-replace intent and recovers a missing receipt; claim reservation, asset publication, binding construction and publisher invocation are idempotent and revalidated on every resume.
closed_findings.real_look_v23_identity: The execution contract schema requires the exact stage2 path, SHA256 and numeric successor job; contract validation rejects any mismatch before the phase journal is created.
